DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入の受付ですね。一緒にお引越しされた方もいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're registering your move here. Did anyone move with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は昨日引越しましたが、妻は来月来ます。今日、二人分をまとめて出すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人は昨日転入し妻は来月なので二人分提出すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved yesterday, but my wife will come next month. Should I submit both our registrations together today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you moved in yesterday and your wife will come next month, and ask whether to submit for both of you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 実際にお住まいになった日と、ご家族の状況を担当窓口で確認します。奥様は今どちらにお住まいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The responsible counter will check the date you actually began living here and your family circumstances. Where does your wife live now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ前の市に住んでいます。勤務の都合で、私より一か月遅れて引越す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻は旧市に居住し勤務事情で一か月後に来ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: She still lives in our previous city. Because of work, she plans to move one month after me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your wife lives in the previous city and will come a month later because of work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずは今日のご本人の手続きを相談しましょう。転出に関する書類はご本人の分をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's first discuss your own procedure today. Do you have your own documents concerning moving out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の分はあります。妻の手続きを勝手に済ませないよう、今日出すものを分けて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の転出書類を示し妻の手続きと区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have mine. I want to check separately what to submit today so I don't complete my wife's procedure on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your own moving-out documents and say you want to distinguish them from your wife's procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類を分けたまま担当へお渡しください。奥様の転入予定についても相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give the documents to the person responsible while keeping them separate. You can also discuss your wife's planned move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妻が来るとき、本人が持参するものをあらかじめ知りたいです。予定日が変わったら相談し直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 妻の持ち物と予定日変更時の再相談について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to know in advance what she herself needs to bring when she comes. Can we consult again if her planned date changes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what your wife needs to bring and about consulting again if the planned date changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予定が変われば、その状況を担当へ伝えてください。必要なものは現時点の説明として確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the plan changes, tell the person responsible about the circumstances. Let's check the required items as guidance based on the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、私の手続きを先に進めて、妻の分は持ち物と相談先だけ控えて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人分を進め妻の必要物と相談先だけ控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll proceed with my own registration first, and just note my wife's required items and where to consult before going home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will proceed with your own procedure and only note your wife's required items and consultation contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人の受付と、後日ご家族が来る際の相談を分けてお伝えします。こちらの窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll explain your reception procedure separately from consultation about your family coming later. Please go to this counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次の受診について相談されたいのですね。予約票を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss your next appointment. May I see the appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を一緒に聞く友人が、その日に来られなくなりました。予約を別の日に変えられるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が来られず受診予約の日程変更を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The friend who was going to listen to the explanation with me can no longer come that day. I'd like to ask about changing to another date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your friend cannot come and you want to discuss rescheduling your medical appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日程を確認する前に、付き添いが必要な理由を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before checking dates, could you tell me why you need someone to accompany you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 詳しい日本語が難しく、友人に言葉を補ってもらうつもりでした。説明を聞き違えるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 詳しい日本語を聞き違える心配で友人の補助を予定していたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Detailed Japanese is difficult for me, so I planned to have my friend help with the language. I'm worried about misunderstanding the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you planned to have a friend's help because you worry about misunderstanding detailed Japanese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのご事情を担当へ伝えます。変更以外に、院内で相談できる支援があるかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person responsible about that. Let's also check whether there is support within the hospital besides changing the appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 支援があるなら、一人で来る方法も考えたいです。どんな対応が可能か教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支援があれば単独来院も考えるので可能な対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there is support, I'd consider coming alone too. Could you tell me what assistance is possible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you would consider coming alone if support is available, and ask what assistance is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる対応は担当者に確認します。予約の変更を希望する場合、友人が来られる日は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person responsible about available assistance. If you want to reschedule, do you know which day your friend can come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 翌週の月曜なら一緒に来られます。ただ、そこまで受診を延ばしてよいかは私では判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌週月曜は同行可能だが受診延期の可否は判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We can come together the following Monday. But I can't judge whether it's all right to delay the consultation until then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your friend can accompany you the following Monday, but you cannot judge whether delaying the consultation is acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受診時期の判断が必要なことも、医療スタッフへ伝えます。今の予約は相談結果が出るまで残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll also tell the medical staff that the timing needs a medical decision. Let's keep the current appointment until the consultation outcome is known.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の予約はそのままにしてください。支援の確認と日程の相談をした後で、どうするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支援と日程の確認後に決めるため元の予約を残してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please keep the original appointment. I'll decide what to do after checking the support and discussing the dates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to retain the original appointment so you can decide after checking support and dates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な説明を受けられるよう相談を引き継ぎます。回答までお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass on your request so you can receive the explanations you need. Please wait for the answer. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車についてのご相談ですね。見当たらなくなったのは、どのような状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss your bicycle. What happened when you found it missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪場に戻ったら自分の自転車がなく、似たものが一台ありました。でも、私のものではないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自車がなく似た自転車があるが別物と思うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I returned to the bicycle parking area, mine was gone and there was a similar bicycle. But I don't think it's mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your bicycle is missing and there is a similar one, but you think it is different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 似ている自転車を、動かしたり乗ったりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you moved or ridden the similar bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 触っていません。私の車体には白いステッカーがありますが、その一台には付いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 類似車体は未接触で自車の白いステッカーがないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched it. Mine has a white sticker, but that one didn't have it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched the similar bicycle and it lacks your bicycle's white sticker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外見の違いを記録しましょう。ご自分の自転車を確認できる番号や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's record the differences in appearance. Do you have a number or photograph that can identify your own bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 購入時の写真と車体番号のメモがあります。防犯登録の控えも、スマホに保存しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入写真車体番号メモ防犯登録控えがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a photograph from when I bought it and a note of the frame number. I've saved a copy of the anti-theft registration on my phone too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a purchase photograph, a frame-number note, and a copy of the anti-theft registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認に使える資料ですね。最後に自分の自転車を停めた区画は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Those are useful for identification. Do you remember the section where you last parked your bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から二列目の端です。朝はそこに置きましたが、昼に戻ったときは空いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口二列目の端に朝置き昼には空いていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the end of the second row from the entrance. I left it there in the morning, but it was empty when I came back at noon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you left it at the end of the second row from the entrance in the morning and the space was empty at noon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その場所と時刻を伺います。似た車体を自分で持ち帰らず、確認が必要なことを担当へ伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask about that place and time. Rather than taking the similar bicycle home yourself, let's tell the person responsible it needs checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真と番号を照合してもらいたいです。違う車体を動かさず、相談した内容を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 類似車体を動かさず写真と番号で確認し記録してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like you to compare the photograph and number. Please record what I've told you without moving the other bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to verify using the photograph and number and record your report without moving the similar bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料とお話を受け付けます。確認するため、担当へ引き継ぎますね。ご相談ありがとうございました。お帰りもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll accept your documents and account. I'll pass them to the person responsible for checking. Thank you for consulting us. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒が二通ありますね。同じ送り方をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two envelopes. Would you like to send them the same way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宛先が別々です。青い印の封筒だけ、配達の記録が残る方法で送るよう指定されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い印だけ配達記録の指定があり宛先は別と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: They have different destinations. Only the envelope with the blue mark is required to be sent by a method that leaves a delivery record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the destinations differ and only the blue-marked envelope has a delivery-record requirement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もう一通は、指定された送り方がありますか。封筒ごとに確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is a method specified for the other envelope? Let's check each separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう一通には指定がありません。二つを混同しないように、先に青い印の方からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: もう一通に指定はなく青い印から処理して混同を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nothing is specified for the other one. Please handle the blue-marked one first so the two don't get mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the other one has no specified method and you want to handle the blue-marked one first to avoid confusion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 青い印の宛先について、求められる記録の内容は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: For the blue-marked destination, do you know what kind of record is required?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内文には配達した記録とあります。追跡番号だけで足りるのか、その文を見て確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達記録の指示に追跡番号だけで足りるか案内文で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The instructions say a record of delivery. I'd like you to read that sentence and check whether a tracking number alone is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check from the instructions whether a tracking number alone meets the delivery-record requirement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内文だけで判断できない場合は提出先へ確認が必要です。サービスごとの記録の違いをご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the instructions alone do not make it clear, you need to confirm with the receiving organization. I'll explain how the records differ by service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 指定に合う方法が分かったら、それで青い方を送ります。もう一通は料金を比べてから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い方は指定適合の方法でもう一通は料金比較後に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once we know a method that meets the requirement, I'll use it for the blue one. I'd like to compare prices before deciding for the other one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use a compliant method for the blue one and decide for the other after comparing prices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、二通の重さを別々に測ります。控えが出る場合も、それぞれの宛先と照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll weigh the two separately. If receipts are issued, please compare each with its destination too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えには自分で宛先の略称をメモします。どちらの番号か分からなくならないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先略称を控えにメモして番号の取り違えを防ぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write a shortened name for the destination on each receipt myself. I don't want to lose track of which number belongs to which.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note abbreviated destination names on the receipts to prevent mixing up the numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛先と控えを順番に確認して受付します。二通とも取り違えないよう進めますね。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the destinations and receipts in order as we accept them. We'll proceed carefully so neither gets mixed up. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のご相談ですね。お持ちの用紙には、家賃の振替と書かれていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss an account. The form you have says rent direct debit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい部屋の家賃を引き落とすために口座を作りたいです。この用紙を出せば、開設も済むのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃振替用紙の提出だけで口座開設も済むのか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to open an account for my new room's rent to be debited. If I submit this form, does that also finish opening the account?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether submitting the rent direct-debit form alone also completes opening an account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座開設と振替の登録は別の確認が必要です。まず、こちらにお持ちの口座はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Account opening and direct-debit registration require separate checks. First, do you already have an account with us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありません。大家さんから用紙だけ先にもらったので、番号の欄も空白です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 既存口座がなく大家からの用紙の番号欄は空白と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. My landlord gave me just this form in advance, so the account-number field is blank too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have no existing account and the number field on your landlord's form is blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、開設の申込方法と必要書類を確認しましょう。振替先として使える条件も調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check how to apply to open one and which documents are needed. We'll also check the conditions for using it for direct debit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類は持っています。用紙に書かれた銀行の条件に合うかも見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認書類を示し用紙の銀行条件と適合するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have identification documents. Could you also check whether it meets the bank conditions written on the form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your identification and ask whether it meets the form's bank conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 条件とご本人の状況を担当窓口で確認します。開設できるかどうかは、その確認後のご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible counter will check the conditions and your circumstances. We can tell you whether opening is possible only after that check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし口座の準備が間に合わなければ、初回の家賃は別の払方を大家さんに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座準備が遅れれば初回家賃の別払いを大家へ相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the account isn't ready in time, I'll ask my landlord about another way to pay the first rent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the landlord about a different payment method for the first rent if the account is not ready in time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点は大家さんへの確認が必要ですね。銀行では、申込と振替登録の進め方を順番にご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: That does need checking with the landlord. At the bank, we'll explain the application and direct-debit registration steps in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に開設の条件を確かめて、口座が用意できてから番号を記入します。今日の用紙は持ち帰ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開設条件確認後に番号を記入し用紙を持ち帰れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the opening conditions first and fill in the number once the account is ready. May I take today's form home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may take the form home, saying you will fill in the number after checking opening conditions and preparing the account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 用紙を預かる必要があるかも担当に確認します。今はお手元にお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。それでは窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll also ask the person responsible whether we need to retain the form. Please keep it with you for now. Thank you for consulting us. Please go to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計前の商品確認ですね。どの表示が気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check an item before paying. Which label concerned you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚では特売になっていたのに、価格を調べたら違う額でした。このコーヒーを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の特売表示と照会額が違うコーヒーを確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was marked on sale on the shelf, but when I checked the price it was different. Could you look at this coffee?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to check coffee whose queried price differs from the shelf's sale label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の容量を確認します。棚にあった札は、何グラムの商品を示していましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the bag size. How many grams did the shelf label refer to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは見ていません。赤い札がすぐ下にあったので、この袋の値段だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容量を見ず直下の赤札が自商品の価格と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't look that closely. A red label was directly beneath it, so I thought that was this bag's price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not check the size and thought the red label directly below was your item's price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この袋は二百グラムです。棚の札と商品名、容量、番号を照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This bag is two hundred grams. Let's compare the shelf label with the product name, size, and number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ銘柄なら同じ特売だと思っていました。容量が違う商品も近くにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同銘柄の特売と思ったが違う容量の商品があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought the same brand meant the same sale. Are there products of a different size nearby too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you assumed the same brand was on sale, and ask whether there are other sizes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 棚には小さい袋もあります。その札は小さい袋のものか確認しますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are smaller bags on the shelf too. I'll check whether that label belongs to the smaller bag, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい袋が対象なら、そちらに替えたいです。飲み切れる量で買いたいので、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋が対象なら飲み切れる量なので替えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the smaller bag is the one on sale, I'd like to switch to it. I want an amount I can finish drinking, so please show me where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to switch if the smaller bag is on sale, since it is an amount you can finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したところ、この札は小さい袋の表示でした。こちらをご案内します。元の袋は私が戻しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've checked: this label was for the smaller bag. I'll show you. I'll put the original bag back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら、小さい方を一つ買います。元の袋は会計に入れないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 小袋一つだけを購入し元の袋を会計から除くよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll buy one smaller bag. Please make sure the original bag is not included in the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to buy only one smaller bag and exclude the original bag from the bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小さい袋だけで価格を確認してお会計します。表示についてお尋ねいただきありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the price and charge for the small bag only. Thank you for asking about the label. Please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 雨がやみましたね。散歩の前に、道を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The rain has stopped. Would you like to check the paths before your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事へ行く前に少し歩きたいのですが、この靴を汚したくありません。舗装された道はどれですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出勤前の散歩で靴を汚さないよう舗装路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a short walk before work, but I don't want these shoes to get dirty. Which path is paved?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a paved path so you will not dirty your shoes on a walk before work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図ではこの道が舗装路です。ただ、雨上がりなので水たまりが残っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one is the paved path on the map. However, since it has just rained, puddles may remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 乾いているとは限らないんですね。水が深ければ別の道へ進まず、その場で戻るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 深い水があれば別道へ進まずその場で戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't necessarily dry. If the water is deep, I plan to turn back there rather than go onto another path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will turn back where you are if the water is deep, rather than go down a different path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その方が道に迷いにくいですね。どこかで休憩する予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You're less likely to get lost that way. Are you planning to rest anywhere?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 屋根のある場所で五分ほど座りたいです。今いる入口から遠くない場所が分かれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口近くで五分座れる屋根のある場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to sit somewhere covered for about five minutes. If you know somewhere not far from this entrance, please tell me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a covered place near the entrance where you can sit for five minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休憩場所の表示はこちらです。使えるかどうかは、現地の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the sign for the rest area. Please also check the information at the site to see whether it is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし通行止めの札があったら、地図に道があっても入らない方がいいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図上の道でも現地の通行止め札に従うべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If there's a path-closed sign, I shouldn't enter even if the path appears on the map, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should obey an on-site closure sign even for a path shown on the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、現地の表示を優先してください。近道を探して別の区域へ入るのは避けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, give priority to the signs at the site. Avoid entering another area to look for a shortcut.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 舗装路を入口から往復して、休憩場所が使えなければそこで引き返します。出勤に遅れない範囲にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口から舗装路往復と休憩不可なら折返しを出勤時間内に行うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll go out and back along the paved path from the entrance, and turn back at the rest area if I can't use it. I'll keep it within the time that won't make me late for work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk out and back on the paved path from the entrance and turn back if the rest area is unavailable, without being late for work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻る場所と時間を決めておくと安心ですね。雨上がりですから足元に気をつけて。では、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's reassuring to decide where and when to return. Watch your step as it has just rained. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 経路のご相談ですね。帰りの予定も決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like route advice. Have you decided your return plans too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行きだけ検索しました。夕方に帰るときも、同じ駅で乗り換えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行きのみ検索済みで夕方の帰りも同じ乗換駅か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've only searched the outward journey. When returning in the evening, should I change at the same station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have only searched the outward trip and ask whether the evening return uses the same transfer station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 往路を逆にしても、帰る時間に接続するとは限りません。帰りはどこから何時ごろ出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Reversing the outward route does not necessarily mean the connections work at your return time. Where and around what time will you leave on the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅を六時ごろ出ます。用事が長引いた場合の便も、見ておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅を示し六時頃と予定が長引く場合も確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave this station around six. I'd also like to check services in case my errand takes longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the station and say you want to check around six and also in case your plans run late. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰りの出発駅と時刻で検索しましょう。行きの条件を残さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's search using the return departure station and time. Make sure the outward journey conditions are not left in place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りに切り替えました。この候補は二十分待つのですね。待つ駅も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りに切替え二十分待つ駅を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've switched to the return trip. This option has a twenty-minute wait. I'd like to check which station I'll wait at too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have switched to the return trip and ask which station has the twenty-minute wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乗り換え駅の欄をご覧ください。待ち時間と、次に乗る方向を分けて確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at the transfer-station field. Let's check the waiting time separately from the direction of the next train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅名をメモします。六時に乗れなければ、その場で時刻を変えて再検索すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅名を記録し六時に乗れない場合の再検索を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll note the station name. If I can't take the six o'clock service, should I change the time there and search again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the station name and ask about searching again if you cannot take the six o'clock service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最新の運行案内も確認してください。遅い時間は選べる便が減る場合もあるので、帰る前に調べ直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the latest service information too. There may be fewer options later, so search again before heading back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予定が変わったら再検索します。行きと帰りの画面は分けて保存します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復画面を分け予定変更時は再検索する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll search again if plans change. I'll save the outward and return screens separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the outward and return screens separate and search again if plans change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 画面を見間違えないようにしてくださいね。それでは、帰りの接続にも気をつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care not to confuse the screens. Have a safe trip, and watch the return connections too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の提出先と、指定の書類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me where you will submit the certificate and which document is specified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの奨学金の申請です。前年の所得を証明するよう書いてありますが、何年度の証明書かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 奨学金用前年所得証明の年度がわからないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my child's scholarship application. It says to certify the previous year's income, but I don't know which fiscal year's certificate that means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you do not know the fiscal year of the certificate for previous-year income required for a scholarship. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 所得の対象年と証明書の年度は区別して確認しましょう。案内の該当部分を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's distinguish the year the income relates to from the certificate's fiscal year. Please show me the relevant part of the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここには対象年だけあります。年度を勝手に選ばず、対応するものを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象年のみあり年度を勝手に選ばず確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only gives the income year here. Rather than choosing a fiscal year myself, I'd like to check which one corresponds to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say only the income year is given and you want to check rather than choose a fiscal year on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を担当に確認します。証明できる窓口を調べるため、転居された時期も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check that information with the person responsible. To find the issuing counter, may I also ask when you moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 去年の春、別の市から引っ越しました。以前の住所も必要なら伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 去年春に他市から転居し以前の住所も知らせると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I moved from another city last spring. I'll give my former address too if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you moved from another city last spring and can provide your former address too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転居時期も含めて発行先を確認します。ここで発行できるとは、まだお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check where it can be issued, including when you moved. I cannot promise yet that we can issue it here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発行できる市を先に調べます。提出先には証明書の正式な名称も聞いたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発行する市を調べ正式名称も提出先に尋ねるか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll first find out which city can issue it. Should I also ask the receiving organization for the certificate's official name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will find the issuing city and ask whether to confirm the official name with the receiving organization. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名称や必要な記載が不明なら確認してください。誰の所得を証明する指定かも大切です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If the name or required details are unclear, please check. It also matters whose income they require proof of.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人分か保護者分かも聞きます。名称と対象者がわかったら、発行先を担当に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人か保護者か確認し名称と対象者を担当へ伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask whether it's the applicant's or guardian's income too. Once I know the name and whose it is, I'll consult the person responsible about where it can be issued.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm whether it is the applicant's or guardian's and tell the person responsible the name and covered person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内を持って担当へお進みください。それでは、対象年と年度を整理してから申請をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the instructions to the person responsible. Discuss the application after clarifying the income year and fiscal year.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 薬の欄を確認されていますね。現在お使いの薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking the medication field. Are you currently using any medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、市販薬を飲みましたが、名前を思い出せません。「なし」と書いてもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日市販薬を飲んだが薬名不明でなしと記入できるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took an over-the-counter medicine yesterday, but I can't remember its name. May I write “none”?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you took an over-the-counter medicine yesterday but do not know its name, and ask whether you may write none. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲んだ薬があるなら、名前がわからないことを伝えてください。箱や説明書は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: If you took medicine, please say you do not know the name. Do you still have the box or instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に箱があります。家族に頼めば、名前の部分を写真で送ってもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族から箱の名前部分の写真を送ってもらえると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The box is at home. If I ask my family, they can send a photograph of the name on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your family can send a photograph of the name on the box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できた写真は診察で医師に見せてください。飲んだ時間や量は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Show the confirmed photograph to the doctor during the consultation. Do you remember the time and amount you took?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜の食後に一回です。錠数は箱を見ないと自信がないので、推測では書きたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨夜食後一回で錠数不明と推測しない旨を説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Once after dinner last night. I'm not sure of the number of tablets without seeing the box, so I don't want to guess when writing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it was once after dinner last night, the tablet count is unknown, and you will not guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかることと不確かなことを分けて書きましょう。他に使っている薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's separate what you know from what is uncertain. Are you using any other medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ほかはありません。写真が届くまで、薬名が未確認と書いて提出できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他薬なしで薬名未確認の記入を相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No others. Until the photograph arrives, can I submit it with the medicine name marked as unconfirmed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there are no other medicines and ask about writing the name as unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未確認とわかるように記入してください。確認後の薬の使用については、医師に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write it so it is clear that it is unconfirmed. Discuss taking the medicine with the doctor once it has been identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真を医師に見せ、量が不明なことも説明します。次に飲む前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真と量不明を医師へ伝え次の服用前に相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the photograph to the doctor and explain that the amount is unknown too. I'd like to check before taking it next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the doctor about the photograph and unknown amount, and consult before the next dose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 覚えている情報をそのまま伝えてくださいね。それでは、記入が終わりましたら問診票をこちらへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell them exactly what you remember. Once you have finished filling it in, bring the questionnaire here.
